name: Agent Skills Index
summary: Skill registry for Codex and Claude Code with license checks, provenance, review states and installable packages.
description: An open index of agent skills for Codex, Claude Code and compatible agents: it splits public sources into individual skill packages, records each package's license and source commit, and runs static checks and isolated copies before offering installs. 41 skills are direct-install across 7 categories; 727 packages are indexed by review state, and the source index tracks 1,674 repos with 300+ stars. README is in Chinese.
contains: 41 direct-install skills across 7 categories (design, engineering, growth, product, research, workflow, writing)
727 skill packages indexed: 41 direct, 648 extracted pending review, 38 needs-review
1,674 source repos over 300 stars indexed, 1,670 containing SKILL.md
3-minute demo script (Python stdlib) copies and re-hashes a skill without touching your skill directory
own content Apache-2.0; third-party skills keep their own LICENSE and NOTICE
